The Cubs played 162 regular-season games in 2026 and 86 of them (53%) had no run in the first inning, the result an NRFI bet needs. They scored in the first in 28% of their games and allowed a first-inning run in 24%. Everything below is counted from the official line scores through September 27, 2026.

| Home | 81 | 37 | 44 | 46% |
| Away | 81 | 49 | 32 | 60% |
